description: This file defines the class `Image_Graph_Axis`, which handles rendering and configuration of axes (X or Y) for a graph or chart within the Image_Graph package. It includes methods for setting axis ranges, labels, ticks, styles, and intersection points, and contains logic for drawing the axes and ticks on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis
classes.description: A class for managing and rendering a linear axis (X or Y) in a graph, supporting customization of range, labels, ticks, styles, and intersections.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis
methods.description: Constructor for the axis, initializing the axis type and default style.

methods.name: _pushValues
methods.description: Enables shifting axis labels/values by 0.5, useful for certain chart types like bar or step charts.

methods.name: _setAxisPadding
methods.description: Sets padding in pixels for the axis at 'low' or 'high' ends.

methods.name: _getTitleFont
methods.description: Retrieves font options used for axis title, falling back to default fonts if not explicitly set.

methods.name: showLabel
methods.description: Configures which labels (minimum, zero, maximum) should be rendered on the axis.

methods.name: setDataPreProcessor
methods.description: Assigns a data preprocessor to format axis labels (e.g., date formatting).

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the current minimum value of the axis.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the current maximum value of the axis.

methods.name: _setMinimum
methods.description: Sets the minimum axis value, respecting whether it was explicitly enforced.

methods.name: _setMaximum
methods.description: Sets the maximum axis value.

methods.name: forceMinimum
methods.description: Forcefully sets the axis minimum value, bypassing previous settings if needed.

methods.name: forceMaximum
methods.description: Forcefully sets the axis maximum value.

methods.name: showArrow
methods.description: Enables drawing an arrow head at the end of the axis line.

methods.name: hideArrow
methods.description: Disables drawing an arrow head at the end of the axis line.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the pixel distance between adjacent labels at a given level.

methods.name: setLabelInterval
methods.description: Defines the interval at which labels are displayed, can be 'auto' or a specific value.

methods.name: setLabelOption
methods.description: Sets specific display options for labels at a given level, such as formatting, font, and position.

methods.name: setLabelOptions
methods.description: Bulk sets multiple label options for a specified level.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Assigns a title to the axis, with options for orientation (vertical/horizontal).

methods.name: setFixedSize
methods.description: Sets a fixed size (width/height) for the axis in pixels.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Preprocesses a value (e.g., for logarithmic axes).

methods.name: _applyDataset
methods.description: Applies dataset boundaries (min/max) to axis configuration.

methods.name: _point
methods.description: Converts an axis value into a pixel coordinate on the canvas.

methods.name: _intersectPoint
methods.description: Calculates pixel position where the axis intersects another axis at a specific value.

methods.name: _calcDelta
methods.description: Calculates the number of pixels representing one unit on the axis.

methods.name: _calcLabelInterval
methods.description: Calculates an optimal interval for labels based on axis span and configuration.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Provides the next label value for a given level and current label.

methods.name: _labelInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the label interval for a specified level.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Calculates the pixel size of the axis, including labels and titles.

methods.name: addMark
methods.description: Adds a visual mark at a specific axis value, optionally a range.

methods.name: _isNumeric
methods.description: Returns true if the axis is numeric.

methods.name: setTickOptions
methods.description: Configures tick line placement at a level.

methods.name: setInverted
methods.description: Inverts the axis direction (e.g., top-to-bottom instead of bottom-to-top).

methods.name: setAxisIntersection
methods.description: Sets the value at which this axis intersects another axis.

methods.name: _getAxisIntersection
methods.description: Retrieves current intersection configuration for the axis.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, mainly label cache.

methods.name: _drawTick
methods.description: Draws a tick mark and optional label at a specific value and level.

methods.name: _drawAxisLines
methods.description: Draws the main axis line and arrowheads.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates axis coordinates and recalculates delta (pixel per unit).

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the axis, including axis line, ticks, and labels, onto the canvas.
